scope: All 11 native objects; domain-state equations and one source-defined observed product projection

source_to_graph.disposition: Native Yersinia YbtE controller and petrobactin citation rejected; Pseudomonas PchD supported independently.
Shared cysteine-adenylation object used once per module (flux twice); native petrobactin citation is not Pch proof.
Second cysteine loading; retain separate PchF carrier class.
Cyclization/epimerization composite scope requires explicit evidence. Primary 2003 and 2022 distinguish free L-cysteine loading from subsequent epimerization.
Second condensation/cyclization; do not replace the protein-bound intermediate with an isolated oxidized shunt product.
NADPH-dependent reduction while tethered to PchF; free analogue kinetics have a separate scope.
SAM-dependent late N-methylation; current primary supports reduction before methylation, subject to analogue and construct limits.
Product release by embedded PchF thioesterase. PchC editing is distinct and is not assigned this terminal step.
Cysteine loading to PCP domain; original carrier class, not a count of whole polypeptides.
Salicyl transfer to the PchE ArCP domain; original carrier class.
Condensation involving two reactive domains of PchE; source PchE coefficient does not denote two whole enzyme molecules.
